Name: Sav's Natty Ostrich Reskin Variety
Author: MM1991
Description:
I adore the goofy noodleneck linework of the ostriches, but they're a little lacking in color. Sav's new ostrich babies are hide-in-the-grass camo, just like real life, and correspond in small details to the adult sprites. There are 3 "male" adult sprites, 3 "female" adult sprites, one baby-feathers adult, and 3 leucistics, or rhea hybrids, however you want to rp in your game. Up to 10 new colors for your ratites! These sprites are intended to plug into your [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2274]More Animals[/url] OR [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n' Skin[/url] mod.

Ostrich_11.png and BabyOstrich_11.png are the unedited SDV linework. I do not own the artwork, but I did small additions to the lines for these recolor edits.

[size=4][b]Install [/b][/size]
Instructions vary depending on your mod choice! But this is how you install with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2274]More Animals[/url] OR [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n' Skin[/url] (they aren't compatible):
1. Download and open Sav's folder up to them .pngs
2. Also open your "Stardew Valley>Mods>moreanimals>assets>skins" OR "Stardew Valley>Mods>adoptskin>assets>skins" 
3. Drag all .png sprites (or only the ones you like most) from Sav's folder into your "skins" folder.
4. Run game + SMAPI. If this is your first install of the reskin mod, or first time adding skins for this type of animal, they will be randomly assigned to animals in a preexisting save file I think. Yay!

These may not be enough, as I considered making 2 additional "male" sprites with more blue necks, but the pink felt iconic enough for now. Originally had a ton more planned, but decided that there should be 2 separate packs for ostrich patterns with unedited lines, and other ratites with different proportions. So look out for Sav's Exotic Ostrich Kin Reskin. Someday. Some year. :)
